stories.title: Gold Rebounds as Bond Jitters and a Weaker Dollar Revive Demand
stories.summary: Gold prices rebounded on August 21. CNBC reports that bond market jitters, debt fears, and a weaker dollar pushed investors back toward bullion. The move points to renewed demand for safe-haven assets.
stories.whyItMatters: Gold's rebound signals that investors want a hedge against inflation and rate risk, worth watching alongside bonds and currencies.
